items.title: 18.3 Dominance relations and multiple alleles (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of dominance relations (PDF 90).

blocks.text: Yy matar mein dominant allele Y poori tarah zahir hota hai aur recessive y bilkul nahi, is liye Yy mein koi darmiyani (hari) khasiyat nahi aati. Isay complete dominance kehte hain.

Jab sciencedanon ne Mendel ke khayalat jaanche to nataij hamesha aik jaise na the. Bohat si khasiyatein complete dominance nahi dikhatin, aur kuch do se zyada alleles se qaboo hoti hain. Agle topics incomplete dominance, co-dominance aur multiple alleles ke baare mein hain.

blocks.explanation: Heterozygote mein dominant allele poora zahir aur recessive bilkul nahi, is liye heterozygote dominant homozygote jaisa dikhta hai (Yy peela).

items: Istisna: incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles.
